pages.contents: Supplementary Table 1: Baseline laboratory investigations in an infant with severe COVID-19. A three-column table (Microbiological, Haematological and biochemical, Inflammatory markers) of bulleted values with normal ranges: SARS-CoV-2 PCR positive in oro/nasopharyngeal specimens and urine and equivocal in blood, blood cultures negative, haemoglobin, platelets, white cell count, lymphocytes, neutrophils, urea, creatinine, alanine aminotransferase, ferritin, lactate dehydrogenase, procalcitonin, D-dimer and troponin. Footnote NR=normal range.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Baseline laboratory values of the single infant cited by the Results; transcribed and typed in the supplement clinical payload.
limitations: AI source review of rendered pages, not physician adjudication; the PDF prints no separate license notice, so rights are recorded as unclear and the article CC BY license is provenance only.

pages.contents: Supplementary Table 2: viral load inferred from Ct values. A bordered table with columns Time-point (in relation to admission to ICU/intubation, T=0), Date of collection, Cycle threshold (Ct value) and Quantification cycle (Cq) and viral load (copies/ml) in urine samples with sub-columns RdRp#, E^ and RdRp^, for rows Day -2 (symptom onset), 3, 5, 6, 10, 15, 22, 28 and 107; some cells print Not detected or a dash. Footnotes name the E-gene kit for day 5-28 samples and a different hospital laboratory multiplex tandem PCR for the Day -2 sample.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Serial Ct and urine viral load values of the single infant; transcribed and typed in the supplement clinical payload.
limitations: AI source review of rendered pages, not physician adjudication; the PDF prints no separate license notice, so rights are recorded as unclear and the article CC BY license is provenance only.
Collection dates (day/month, no year) are printed but not transcribed.

pages.contents: Supplementary Figure 1: grouped bar chart titled FlowSOM clusters with y axis % leukocytes (ticks 0 to 60, with an axis break) and nine colour-coded cluster groups (eosinophils, neutrophils, NK cells, B cells, CD4 T, CD8 T, CD16+ monocytes, classical monocytes, immature gran), each with five bars labelled 3, 5, 10, 28, 84. Caption describes unsupervised whole-blood flow cytometry analysis.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Plot of the infant FlowSOM cluster frequencies with no printed data values; the same data appear in Supplementary Data 1 (Fig 2b sheet). No readings transcribed.
limitations: AI source review of rendered pages, not physician adjudication; the PDF prints no separate license notice, so rights are recorded as unclear and the article CC BY license is provenance only.

pages.contents: Supplementary Figure 2: thirteen small grouped bar charts (IL-1β, IL-1ra, IL-8, Eotaxin, FGF basic, G-CSF, GM-CSF, MCP-1, MIP-1α, MIP-1β, RANTES, PDGF, VEGF) in pg/ml with x labels Control and 84 and a legend Unstimulated and Virus. Caption states upregulation after SARS-CoV-2 stimulation of PBMCs at day 84 in the infected patient but not in the control.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Plots of day 84 PBMC supernatant cytokines with no printed data values; the same values appear in Supplementary Data 1 (sheet Supp Fig 3). No readings transcribed.
limitations: AI source review of rendered pages, not physician adjudication; the PDF prints no separate license notice, so rights are recorded as unclear and the article CC BY license is provenance only.

pages.contents: Supplemental Figure 3: whole blood flow cytometry gating strategy shown as a grid of coloured dot plots with printed gate names (gran, neut, eos, immature gran, B cells, T cells, DCs, monocytes, NC, int, C, NK cells, CD8 T, CD4 T) and axis marker labels, with a day 3 and a day 10 inset. Caption describes the gating of granulocytes, T cells, B cells, monocyte subsets, dendritic cells and NK cells.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Laboratory gating methods illustration; no patient measurements.
limitations: AI source review of rendered pages, not physician adjudication; the PDF prints no separate license notice, so rights are recorded as unclear and the article CC BY license is provenance only.

pages.contents: Supplementary Table 3: flow cytometry antibody cocktail for whole blood phenotyping, a four-column table (Surface Marker, Fluorophore, Clone, Final Dilution) with 14 rows from CD14 to Live/dead.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Reagent list for laboratory methods; no patient data.

pages.contents: Supplementary Figure 4: PBMC gating strategy shown as a hierarchy of dot plots with printed gate names (Live singlets, Lymphocytes, CD3+, CD8+, γδTCR+Vδ2+, CD161+Vα7.2+, MAIT, CD4+, Treg, Th1, Th2, Th17, memory subsets) and a caption describing T-cell subsets and CD69 gating.
